title: 第二十五章 柳辰的后手第二十六章 劳军
content_zh:
果然，下午的时候就有一队骑兵进入了军营。
等柳辰收到消息出来的时候，发现来的不是别人，正是府里的管家，林老。
“少爷，您没事真的太好了”
林老看到柳辰，情绪很是激动，眼里隐隐有泪花闪动。
柳辰知道，这位老人不是做戏，而是真的激动的落泪，是真的看到柳辰安然无恙而高兴。
“林老，现在前方的战事怎么样？”
在柳辰的私人帐篷里，柳辰跟林老对面而坐，说着这段时间发生的事情。
前方的战事柳辰从第三大队长吴剑豪那里也了解过一些。
但是肯定不如一直呆在父亲身边的林老知道的详细。
“不太好，底层军团方便相差不多，而且昨天黑甲加入后，乱石坡中的战斗已经可以占据上风了
但是郡主那里渐渐力有不逮，毕竟郡主只是刚刚晋升准武者，甚至都没来得及稳固境界，跟陈峰雄那老匹夫还是有一定差距的”
林老先是兴奋的说起底层的战斗，等说道柳辰父亲那里的时候又是满脸愁容。
战争就是这样，不可能处处占据优势，总有不如意的地方。
至于“乱石坡绞肉场”
的大名他回来后也没少听说，只是没想到现在是己方占优，看来局势并不是很糟糕。
至于父亲那里的情况他也听吴剑豪说过，虽然处于劣势但是也没这么快落败，他倒不是很担心。
因为自己的归来只会让局势越来越好。
“对方的血杀小队没有参与乱石坡的战斗吗？”
在柳辰的印象中，血杀，黑甲这两个完全由武者组成的组织一直都是不相伯仲，很难出现一方压过一方的情况。
“少爷不知道吗？血杀在山脉中追击您时遭到妖兽袭击，损失过半，已经很久没有现身了。”

林老有些疑惑的说道。
“怪不得呢”
柳辰恍然大悟，他一直奇怪当初一直追他很紧的血杀后面怎么突然失去了踪迹呢。
原来是被妖兽攻击损失过大退了出去。
随即柳辰眼中闪过一抹杀意，看来这次该换自己来追杀他们了。
以他现在的实力，就是中级武徒都不一定是他的对手，如果放出傀儡的话，就是高级武徒也可以应付。
对付一个最高战力只有中级武徒的血杀还是没有问题的。
“对了少爷，您是怎么摆脱掉血杀的追杀的，怎么现在才出来，我们已经找您十多天了，怎么一直没发现您的身影”
林老随即问起了自己心中的疑问。
因为当时得到消息柳辰被血杀追杀入山脉深处时，大部分人都觉得柳辰已经殒命在山脉中。
毕竟不管是血杀还是山脉中的妖兽都不是柳辰这样一个毫无经验的菜鸟能应付的。
“这就要从被袭击来说了，当时我们.......”
柳辰把这段时间的遭遇说了一下，当然无常老人的隐秘空间以及沐雨柔的事没有提及。
只是说自己被一个高人所救，并且有了一些奇遇，没有具体说到底遇到什么奇遇，只是一笔带过。
看着静静听自己讲完的林老，柳辰有些不知该说些什么。
content_en:
Sure enough, a group of cavalry entered the military camp in the afternoon.
When Liu Chen received the news, he found that it was none other than the housekeeper of the house, Mr. Lin.
"Master, it's great that you're okay."
When Mr. Lin saw Liu Chen, he was very excited and there were tears in his eyes.
Liu Chen knew that the old man was not acting, but was really moved to tears and was really happy to see Liu Chen safe and sound.
"Mr. Lin, how is the battle ahead now?"
In Liu Chen's private tent, Liu Chen and Mr. Lin sat across from each other and talked about what happened during this period.
Liu Chen also learned about the battle ahead from the third captain Wu Jianhao.
But it's definitely not as detailed as Mr. Lin, who has been staying by his father's side.
"It's not good. The convenience of the lower-level legions is almost the same. Moreover, after the black armor joined yesterday, the battle on the rocky slope has been able to gain the upper hand.
But the princess is gradually running out of power. After all, the princess has just been promoted to a quasi-martial artist and has not even had time to stabilize her realm. There is still a certain gap between the old man Chen Fengxiong."
Mr. Lin first talked excitedly about the fighting at the bottom, but when he talked about Liu Chen's father's place, his face became full of sadness.
War is like this. It is impossible to have an advantage everywhere, and there will always be dissatisfaction.
As for the "Lushipo Meat Mincing Ground"
He had heard a lot about the famous name after he came back, but he didn't expect that his side would have the upper hand now. It seemed that the situation was not very bad.
As for the situation at his father's place, he had also heard from Wu Jianhao that although he was at a disadvantage, he did not lose so quickly, so he was not very worried.
Because his return will only make the situation better and better.
"Didn't the opponent's blood-killing team participate in the battle on the rocky slope?"
In Liu Chen's impression, Blood Kill and Black Armor, two organizations composed entirely of warriors, have always been on par with each other, and it is difficult for one party to overwhelm the other.
"Master, don't you know? When Xue Sha was chasing you in the mountains, he was attacked by monsters. He lost more than half of his body. He has not been seen for a long time."
Mr. Lin said with some doubts.
“No wonder”
Liu Chen suddenly realized that he had always wondered why Xue Sha, who had been chasing him so closely, suddenly lost track of him.
It turned out that he was attacked by a monster and suffered too much damage and retreated.
Then Liu Chen's eyes flashed with murderous intent, it seemed that this time it was his turn to hunt them down.
With his current strength, even intermediate warriors may not be his opponents. If puppets are released, even high-level warriors can handle it.
There is no problem in dealing with a bloody killing of a mid-level warrior with the highest combat power.
"By the way, young master, how did you get rid of the bloody pursuit, and why did you come out now? We have been looking for you for more than ten days, but why have you not been found yet?"
Mr. Lin immediately asked the question in his mind.
Because when they received the news that Liu Chen was being chased deep into the mountains by bloodshed, most people thought that Liu Chen had died in the mountains.
After all, whether it was a bloodbath or a monster in the mountains, it was not something an inexperienced rookie like Liu Chen could handle.
"This comes from the fact that we were attacked. At that time..."
Liu Chen talked about what happened during this period, but of course he didn't mention the secret space of the old man Wu Chang and Mu Yurou.
He just said that he was rescued by an expert and had some adventures. He didn't specify what adventures he encountered. He just mentioned it briefly.
Looking at Mr. Lin who was listening quietly to what he had to say, Liu Chen didn't know what to say.
